name: Inkwell
tagline: A typographic theme for writers, blogs and newsletters, set in Newsreader.
longDescription:
Inkwell is made for words. It is a quiet, typographic theme for essayists, bloggers and newsletters: warm paper, ink-black text, an oxblood accent and marbled endpapers for covers. Headlines and reading text are set in Newsreader, a serif drawn for long reading on screens; menus and meta use Figtree.

It ships a complete publication: a home page with a newspaper-style masthead, a featured essay and recent posts; an archive grouped by year; a full essay page with a dek, byline, pull quote, lists and an author box; an about page, a contact page and a friendly 404. A subscribe box invites readers to sign up as members of your site.

Every colour and type style is a design token, the reading column is kept to about 68 characters, and all text meets WCAG AA contrast. Six original marbled-paper artworks are included, generated for this theme.
